name: How long does kitchen cabinet painting typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen cabinet painting typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen cabinet painting depends on the kitchen's size, the number of cabinets, and the chosen preparation and drying times. Generally, a professional kitchen cabinet painting project can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days. This includes time for thorough cleaning, sanding, priming, applying multiple coats of paint, and proper curing. Factors like complex cabinet designs or extensive repairs can extend this timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen cabinet painting typically takes 3 to 7 days, depending on kitchen size, cabinet count, and preparation needs. This includes cleaning, sanding, priming, painting, and curing.
